title: Coordinate submodules of direct sums
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $J$ a set and $(N_j)_{j\in J}$ a family of $R$-modules, and let $A\subseteq J$. The coordinate submodule $M_A\subseteq\bigoplus_{j\in J}N_j$ consists of precisely those finite-support families whose coordinates outside $A$ are zero. This uses the direct sum of [def-weil-pbc-direct-sum-modules].
